//: The compiler settings every Recueil package shares (ADR-0002).
Only options that mean the same thing from any directory live here. Anything that names a
path — outDir, rootDir, include, tsBuildInfoFile — stays in the package's own tsconfig,
because TypeScript resolves relative paths against the file that declares them, and a
"dist" written here would mean the repository root rather than the package.
A package may add to this, but should not loosen it: the strictness is the point, and it
is far cheaper to keep than to reintroduce.
